description: Traffic Intersection Volumes is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Adelaide. Data from the traffic signalling system (SCATS). The dataset contains hourly traffic volumes for the Adelaide City Council jurisdiction. Metadata: - siteno: Unique site identifier for each intersection. - sitedesc: Brief description of the intersection. - lat: the latitude of that traffic intersection. - lon: the longitude of that traffic intersection. Coverage: City of Adelaide. The portal files it under the publisher City of Adelaide. Its tags are count, intersection, traffic, volumes. It offers 1 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
